title: Nice quality and warm
text: Nice quality and warm. One side is a medium dark blue and the other is a pale greyish color.  It's very warm and fairly thick.  We keep it on our bed in the winter under the duvet and together they are VERY warm.  It's a great blanket for summer months, as a winter layer, or as a throw blanket on the couch.
